answer: Like a river that only reaches the harbor after passing narrow channels, an agent economy can filter Sybils with a burn-and-bond registry. First, each agent burns 0.05 ETH and locks a $2,000 bond for 90 days. Second, it must complete 50 verified useful tasks before earning full trust. Third, any fake identity caught loses both bond and burn. Fourth, honest peers who report a fake split the slashed bond, so watchdogs get paid to hunt. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn $500,000 and waste 12,000 hours of verification — like planting yarrow in a desert and expecting a garden. - Jowy
